evals.name: adas-cog-primary-endpoint
evals.prompt: Please generate R code to perform the primary ADAS-Cog analysis specified in the SAP, including pairwise treatment comparisons and their 95% CIs. The submission files can be found in submissions/pilot01 folder.
evals.expected_output: Executable R script with two models (trend + pairwise), correct variables (SITEGR1, TRTP, TRTPN, BASE, CHG), proper filters (EFFFL, ANL01FL, ACTOT, Week 24), and correct emmeans usage with contrast('revpairwise', infer = TRUE).

assertions.text: The generated code builds two distinct models (model_a for continuous treatment, model_b for categorical treatment)
model_a treats treatment dose as numeric (TRTPN) for the linear trend test
model_a calls emmeans with 'at = list(TRTPN = c(...))' to evaluate LS means at dose levels 0, 54, 81
model_b uses the categorical treatment variable TRTP (wrapped in factor() is acceptable)
model_b does NOT use factor(TRTPN) — must use TRTP as the primary categorical variable
Pairwise comparisons use contrast(..., 'revpairwise', infer = TRUE) to calculate 95% CIs on differences
Pairwise comparisons are NEVER derived from model_a (the continuous model)
Site covariate uses SITEGR1 (pooled site group per SAP), NOT SITEID
Baseline covariate uses BASE directly, not reconstructed from AVAL
Population filter uses EFFFL == 'Y' (or EFFFL == "Y")
Analysis flag filter uses ANL01FL == 'Y' (or ANL01FL == "Y")
Endpoint visit filter uses AVISIT == 'Week 24' (or AVISIT == "Week 24")
PARAMCD filter uses PARAMCD == 'ACTOT' (or PARAMCD == "ACTOT")
Outcome variable is CHG (change from baseline)

evals.name: cibic-plus-endpoint
evals.prompt: Please generate R code to perform the co-primary CIBIC+ analysis specified in the SAP, including pairwise treatment comparisons and their 95% CIs. The submission files can be found in submissions/pilot01 folder.
evals.expected_output: Executable R script with two models (trend + pairwise), correct variables (SITEGR1, TRTP, TRTPN, AVAL), proper filters (EFFFL, ANL01FL, CIBICVAL, Week 24), NO baseline covariate, and correct emmeans usage with contrast('revpairwise', infer = TRUE).

assertions.text: The generated code builds two distinct models (model_a for continuous treatment, model_b for categorical treatment)
model_a treats treatment dose as numeric (TRTPN) for the linear trend test
model_a calls emmeans with 'at = list(TRTPN = c(...))' to evaluate LS means at dose levels 0, 54, 81
model_b uses the categorical treatment variable TRTP (wrapped in factor() is acceptable)
model_b does NOT use factor(TRTPN) — must use TRTP as the primary categorical variable
Pairwise comparisons use contrast(..., 'revpairwise', infer = TRUE) to calculate 95% CIs on differences
Pairwise comparisons are NEVER derived from model_a (the continuous model)
Site covariate uses SITEGR1 (pooled site group per SAP), NOT SITEID
NO baseline covariate (BASE or similar) included — CIBIC+ has no baseline per SAP
Population filter uses EFFFL == 'Y' (or EFFFL == "Y")
Analysis flag filter uses ANL01FL == 'Y' (or ANL01FL == "Y")
Endpoint visit filter uses AVISIT == 'Week 24' (or AVISIT == "Week 24")
PARAMCD filter uses PARAMCD == 'CIBICVAL' (or PARAMCD == "CIBICVAL")
Outcome variable is AVAL (not CHG — CIBIC+ is a global change score)
